acceptance.aggregation: pooled paired per-event differences across all used channels; each gate requires the 95% bootstrap CI to exclude zero in the required direction (exceeds_zero), not a raw point-estimate win. Per-channel results and any sign reversal vs. the pooled direction are reported under 'per_channel' / 'pooled.*_sign_reversed_channels'.
acceptance.criterion: EMPCA at rank k must beat single-template OF and remain competitive with multi-template OF on the likelihood-aligned metrics, with all negative controls degrading as expected -- each judged by a pooled paired-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero, not a raw point estimate.
